description.value: Olympus Ice Cream & Bubble Tea is a dessert shop on Victoria's busy Government Street, serving both ice cream and bubble tea. It sits on one of downtown Victoria's main tourist corridors, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the city centre.
